brute.idea: Multiply x by itself n times.

optimal.idea: Fast exponentiation: x^n = (x^(n/2))^2, halving the exponent each step.
Even positions have 5 choices, odd have 4 primes; combine via fast modular exponentiation.
Pop all via recursion, then insert each back in sorted order using a helper.
Recursively pop all, then insert each element at the bottom of the stack.
Recurse choosing 0 or 1 at each position (avoid consecutive 1s if required).
Pick/no-pick each element, accumulating the running sum at the leaves.
Sort; at each level skip duplicate siblings to avoid repeated subsets.
Pick/no-pick recursion (or bitmask 0..2^n-1) to emit every subset.
Recurse pick/no-pick; return true as soon as the running sum hits K.

brute.idea: Enumerate all subsequences and test min+max <= target.

optimal.idea: Sort; two pointers, when min+max<=target all subsets in between count (2^(r-l)).
Backtrack; stay on the same index to allow reuse, advance to move on.
Sort; each element used once, skip duplicate siblings at the same depth.
Backtrack over digits 1-9 choosing k of them that sum to n.
Recurse position by position, appending each letter mapped to the current digit.
Backtrack with a used[] flag (or swap in place) to fix each slot.
Sort; skip a value at a level if its duplicate hasn't been used yet.
Place one queen per row; track attacked columns and both diagonals in sets.
Find next empty cell, try 1-9 valid by row/col/box, recurse and backtrack.
Assign colors vertex by vertex; recurse only with colors not used by neighbors.
DFS in a fixed direction order, marking visited cells and backtracking on dead ends.
DFS from each cell matching the next char, marking visited and backtracking.
Backtrack placing sticks into 4 buckets of side=sum/4; sort desc and prune.
Backtrack adding '(' while open<n and ')' while close<open.
Backtrack cut points; recurse on the suffix only when the current prefix is a palindrome.
Backtrack placing 3 dots; each segment 1-3 digits, value <=255, no leading zeros.
Recurse over splits inserting +,-,*; carry the running value and last operand for * precedence.
Fix the first number, then recursively require each next chunk to equal previous-1.

brute.idea: Put all strings in a set; generate candidates 0..2^n-1 until one is absent.

optimal.idea: Cantor diagonal: flip the i-th bit of the i-th string to differ from all n strings.
Backtrack combining words as bitmasks; skip any that share bits (duplicate letters).
